title: Build an acronym
description:
Write a function `acronym(text)` that builds an acronym from `text`: the first letter of every word, uppercased, joined together.

Covers source items 18-19 (acronyms for two different phrases) as one exercise.
hints: Idea to consider: split into words, then take each word's first letter
text.split() breaks the phrase into a list of words. A list comprehension like [word[0] for word in words] collects just the first character of each word.
Split text into words, collect each word's first character with a list comprehension, join them with ''.join(), and uppercase the result.
expected_behavior: Returns the uppercase acronym formed from the first letter of every word.
solution:
def acronym(text):
    return ''.join(word[0] for word in text.split()).upper()
explanation: split() first turns the phrase into words; a generator expression then picks out just the first character of each before ''.join() glues them back into one string.
